newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Goodman appoints Barry Ford as CFO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Goodman appoints Barry Ford as CFO.

text.p: Australasian food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Tuesday it had appointed Barry Ford, currently Southcorp Holdings Ltd executive general manager, finance, as its new chief financial officer and finance director.

Ford replaces Les Cullen who surprised investors and analysts in late October when he announced his resignation after only seven months in the job after he failed to win wider managerial responsibilities.
Goodman Fielder said Ford had extensive manufacturing industry experience in Australia and overseas.

"I think that Barry's appointment shows that people have confidence in the rebuilding process that we have started at Goodman Fielder and that the company is now poised to fulfil its potential," chairman David Clarke said.
